pages.text: Land only runs while someone is near it, and force-loaded claims only run while their team is online. To keep a farm going while you sleep, hire a $(bold)steward$().$(br2)The Clerk sells his contract (16 emeralds). Use it where he should live.

Pay him by talking to him. While you are away he keeps the $(bold)3x3 chunks$() around him running and takes $(bold)one emerald every 40 minutes$(). When his purse is empty your land waits for you; nothing is lost.$(br2)He can be killed: wall him in. Dismissing him returns half his purse.
